title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?! — Episode4 The Gentleman Thief and the Chocolate Fairy!

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Episode: Episode4 — The Gentleman Thief and the Chocolate Fairy!
meta.Event Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so this is where they're making their culinary creations! It's like an enormous kitchen...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<This looks like so much fun!
Everyone's making all sorts of different chocolates!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed they are! From what I understand, they're all free to make whatever they like!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Chocolates that look and taste however they imagine with any topping they please!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Really?! That sounds like way too much fun!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I wanna try making some!
Miku would love it if I made some that looked like her!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, wonderful idea!
That may be something I should try...
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But where could Hamano be...
At this rate, we won't have enough time for a table-read, let alone a rehearsal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <He said he went out for some fresh air, right? He couldn't have gone that far... Oh, I think that's him...!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, thank goodness!
Len, stay hidden in my pocket.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Okay!>

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Sorry for taking so long. An emergency just happened to come up...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, that's perfectly understandable!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: More importantly, you really don't look well. Are you sure you're feeling okay...?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine...
Thank you for being so concerned.

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I know we lost a lot of time with me being gone, so let's read through this script and get to rehearsing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line:
You've all been doing a wonderful job.
Now, we'll need to wait for our chocolates to cool.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Me neither. They should turn out pretty well as long as they maintain their shape.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did put quite a lot of effort into yours, Hinomori. If I didn't know any better, I'd think your rabbits and shooting stars were professionally made.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You really inspired me to do better.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A-Are you sure...?
I'm happy with what I made, but I don't think they turned out that well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But thanks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
I hope they turn out really cute♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: They already did while you were decorating them. Aren't you asking for too much at this point...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm not being greedy or anything!
I just can't wait until they're done! Don't you feel the same way, Li'l Bro?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kinda, not really? I do just want to try them already...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That means you're looking forward to yours too! We're both just as excited♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I can't believe how amazing everyone's chocolates look. You can tell they worked really hard on them!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree with you there.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Green Room

rows.Speaker: Employee
rows.Line:
Ready, Hamano, Tenma...?
We need you on stand-by!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Ready...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(It's almost showtime!
You've got this, Tsukasa...!)

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Are they finished yet?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: When are our chocolates gonna be done?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. The little ones seem so excited.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They were smacking their lips the whole time while making them too... Hm?
“Hah hah hah hah!!”

rows.Speaker: Visitors
rows.Line: Wh-What was that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is someone laughing...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hang on... I know that voice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That voice... It can't be...
What would he be doing in a place like this...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What are you jinxing yourself for, Li'l Bro?

“What a sweet smell!
Proof that there is chocolate here!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “I am the great phantom thief, the Choco Maniac! The greatest lover of all things chocolate!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! It's really Tsukasa!
It's your lucky day, Li'l Bro!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
You're making it sound like I brought him here or something.

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Heh heh heh.
I'm sensing some delicious chocolates in these refrigerators!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Your yummy treats will all be mine!
Let's start with the ones in here!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: No!! Stop!!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: We made those chocolates!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Uh oh! Here come all the kids!
They're really eating this stuff up!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Excellent. The guests seem to be enjoying everything so far. Next is...)

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Stop right there, Choco Maniac!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Who goes there?! Chocota?!
You may be some kind of chocolate fairy, but you're not about to get in the way of my fun!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“No, stop right there!
My friends here poured their hearts and souls into these chocolates! They are not for you to take!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Their hearts and souls?
What are you going on about?”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “These are for their own friends and loved ones. They all worked very hard to make these!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “If you still refuse to understand, then why don't we ask some of them? How about you there? From where do you hail...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Me? Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Father
rows.Line: Hehe. Say, “We're from Shibuya.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: We're from Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“Shibuya, is it? Wonderful!
And to whom are you giving these chocolates?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Oh, they're for my mom and dad!
They're my way of saying, “Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Your mother and father? How delightful! That means you must've worked very hard on these!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “G-Grr... Yes, that's very sweet... Fine, I won't take yours...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “But there are plenty more chocolates where that came from! For example, you there, the well-groomed gentleman!”

rows.Speaker: Older Gentleman
rows.Line:
Me?
Um... These are for my wife because she's been so good to me...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why's Tsukasa here...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, well... The guy playing the Choco Maniac... I sort of know him...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, isn't he in the same troupe as Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Kiritani, you know Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, we've spoken a little before.
I didn't realize you also knew him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, I only know him because he's Saki's older brother. He's a good person, but kind of a handful to deal with if you catch my drift...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
He certainly knows how to project his voice, but this is a wonderful show. The little ones seem to really be enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess that's true...

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “How about one last person? Who are you making your chocolates for...?”

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Me...? They're for my friend, Haru, who lives next door to me!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: She always gives me snacks and sweets for Valentine's Day, so I want to give something back for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: And I want to keep doing this for Haru until I'm old and gray!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's so sweet.
They'll get to exchange gifts with each other forever.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it really is...
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Chocota's gone all quiet for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Hm? What's going on...?
The show's still going, right?
Did something happen..?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The one asking questions, Hamano in this case, is supposed to provide a suitable reaction here...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But he may've forgotten, so maybe I should take his place and...)

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
*Sob*
*Cry*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I-Is Chocota crying...?!)
